text:
I stand before a glass-walled conference room, its minimalism and clarity inspiring a sense of order but also a touch of detachment. The reflections induce a slight disorientation, and I become acutely aware of the boundaries and transparencies that both reveal and separate.

Then I move toward a vividly designed wall proclaiming 'R+D.' The energetic colors and bold text evoke curiosity and intellectual excitement. Here, innovation and progress are celebrated, inviting me to ponder humanity's relationship with technology. I feel invigorated, aware that I am part of a continuum of inquiry and discovery.
